items.brief: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing on stablecoin crisis planning
items.why: Highlights need for cross-border coordination as tokenized stablecoins complicate reserve and redemption oversight.

items.brief: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
items.why: Notes tokenization and DeFi openings, but unresolved oversight may shape tokenization rules.

items.brief: IMF finds demand for tokenized stocks, says market is still volatile, illiquid
items.why: Shows tokenized equity demand while flagging liquidity, legal and settlement gaps for tokenization.

items.brief: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
items.why: Indicates tokenization expanding from precious metals into lending and energy asset use cases.

items.brief: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
items.why: Suggests stablecoin payment demand growth in APAC, though understanding remains low for tokenized money.
